title: every class with code in openai_wire reaches the diagnostic mixin
intention: Every class with code in openai_wire reaches DiagnosticBase: OpenAIWireHandler (the class make_handler builds) take it as their first base, so each can run a diagnostic report when we need it, and each behaves as before.
why: Measured 2026-11-11: the build inspector filed inspector-new-finding-every-class-reaches-the-diagnostic-mixin naming OpenAIWireHandler (the class make_handler builds) in openai_wire. Akien, 2026-10-27 (ticket 339a45cee6a1): "any class with code it in should be able to run a diagnostic report when we need it".
how: Import DiagnosticBase from cairn.tools.base.diagnostic in cairn/machines/openai_wire/serve.py and make it the first base of OpenAIWireHandler (the class make_handler builds), keeping every other base. Prove it with cairn/machines/openai_wire/proofs/test_every_openai_wire_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin.py.

clauses.claim: the build inspector's every_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin sieve returns [] for component openai_wire at cairn/machines/openai_wire
OpenAIWireHandler (the class make_handler builds) each subclass DiagnosticBase, keep their original base, and behave as before

decisions.text: D1: DiagnosticBase goes first among the bases, as 668c8d64b4e2 and b13c53dd679c did; the import sits at module level beside the others; nothing else in the class changes.

measured.saw: every_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin finds OpenAIWireHandler (the class make_handler builds) in openai_wire
